conviction_note: abs_move 24 (option-implied 20.3% with a 40%-of-mid spread, against confirmed-print reactions of -49.2%, -29.6% and +26.5% in 2026, and a Q4 / 2027 outlook likely to be the line) times a 53 p_up. The lean is slight: the company has beaten its own guide every 2026 quarter and the FY guide implies a soft Q4, but that pattern is visible, consensus already sits above the Q3 guide, the skew already pays upside, and Meta's US ad prices rising 23% cuts the other way. The findings sum (+1.5) and the scaled number (+1.44) roughly agree by coincidence, not by fitting.

findings.finding: ODDITY has beaten the bar on revenue in each 2026 quarter: Q1 revenue $197.9M was about $10M above consensus, and Q2 revenue was $181M against ~$174.8M consensus with adjusted EBITDA of $13M against an $8-10M company guide. For Q3 the guide is ~$140.5M (-5%) and EBITDA $18-20M, and consensus ($141.3M) already sits a little above the guide, so a repeat beat of +1-4% on revenue and above-range EBITDA is the likely number, but much of it is expected.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (2026-06-02) beat revenue by ~$10M and the stock fell 29.6% on margins, the loss and the guide. Q2 2026 (2026-09-09) beat revenue and EBITDA and rose 26.5%, but on 'worst is behind us' and the reinstated FY guide. The quarter's own beat has not set the sign.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Consensus at $141.3M against a $140.5M guide, and a whisper of $0.32 against $0.30, show the street already expects a small beat. If the beat pattern were fully priced you would expect consensus well above the guide, and it is only 0.6% above.
findings.independence: Q1 beat from Motley Fool, https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/06/02/why-oddity-tech-stock-is-plummeting-today/ (2026-06-02); Q2 consensus $174.8M from TIKR, https://www.tikr.com/blog/oddity-tech-stock-is-up-10-this-week-heres-whether-the-rebound-can-hold. These are different documents from the 6-K.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide (revenue ~-19%, adj. EBITDA $30-32M) implies Q4 revenue down ~10-11% YoY, a step back from Q3's -5%, which management attributed to limited visibility. On a company that beat its EBITDA guide by 30-60% in Q2, a Q3 beat with the FY range held would imply an even weaker Q4. A raised FY range, or a Q4 no worse than Q3, is the most likely upside path at this print, and the 2027 return-to-growth framing is the other half of the line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance has set the sign on every 2026 print: the Q1 guide of ~-30% revenue took the stock -49.2% on 2026-02-25, the weak Q2 guide took it -29.6% on 2026-06-02, and the 'sequential improvement' Q3 guide with FY reinstated took it +26.5% on 2026-09-09.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q4 arithmetic is in the Earnings Whispers preview, so it is visible. What is not priced is the company's habit of guiding low. If the market expected a raise, the stock would not have sold off ~10% over 20 sessions into the print, including ~9.5% on the day before. That said, the upside call skew (-17.7) partly holds this lean.
findings.independence: Q4-implied -10-11% from Earnings Whispers, https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/ODD/22812 (2026-11-03). The cut-against case: Il Makiage repeat orders worsened to -20% from -15%, the ad-partner fix is unresolved and excess inventory runs into 2027, all in the same preview. This is the same company document as finding 1, so read the two together; finding 1 is the quarter and this is the outlook.

findings.finding: Meta's Q3 2026 results: average price per ad up 14% YoY globally and 23% in US & Canada, with impressions up 10%. ODDITY's largest ad partner (third parties name Meta) is the channel whose 'algorithm dislocation' broke Il Makiage's acquisition. Rising North American ad prices into Q4 are a headwind to first-order recovery and to the Q4 / 2027 outlook. Meta credits 'improved ad performance', so cost per acquisition need not rise as fast.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Ad-channel news has been the driver of every large 2026 move (Feb -49.2%, Jun -29.6%, Sep +26.5%), but those were company statements, not platform data.
findings.why_not_priced: It is macro-to-company transmission that ODDITY has not confirmed, so it is a proxy and it is public since late October. If the market had read it as a Q4 problem for ODD, puts would be bid rather than calls (skew is -17.7, upside paid).
findings.independence: Proxy. Meta's own release, https://investor.atmeta.com/investor-news/press-release-details/2026/Meta-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/; ODD's 6-K says the dislocation is moderating but not normalized. Nothing from ODD or another DTC beauty brand confirms Q4 cost pressure.

findings.finding: Similarweb shows ilmakiage.com October 2026 traffic up 9.07% month over month, with its global rank improving from 19,557 to 17,243 over three months. spoiledchild.com is +2.87% MoM (about 5.2M visits) with its rank roughly flat to slightly worse (11,842 to 12,166). This is the first month of Q4 and it supports sequential Il Makiage stabilisation. In Feb 2026 Similarweb ranked ilmakiage.com #4,757, so traffic is still far below the year-ago level.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history of web-traffic data moving this name; the line it would land on, Il Makiage first-order recovery, moved it +26.5% on 2026-09-09.
findings.why_not_priced: Panel web-traffic estimates are not in the sell-side preview, which talks only about Q3 first and repeat orders. If the market had read October as improving, the stock would not have fallen ~10% over 20 sessions into the print. Similarweb estimates are noisy and a +9% month is within normal seasonal noise (October beauty demand ramps), so this is filed small.
findings.independence: Proxy. spoiledchild.com page https://www.similarweb.com/website/spoiledchild.com/ (same vendor). Feb 2026 rank #4,757 from Similarweb's competitor page https://similarweb.com/website/ilmakiage.com/competitors. The company's 'worst is behind us' comment (6-K 2026-09-09) points the same way, but it is a different kind of evidence.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: short interest has halved to 4.0M shares (5.2 days to cover, ~8.7% of shares) from 8.0M at June 30, so much of the squeeze fuel behind the post-September rally is spent. The largest holder, Baillie Gifford, trimmed to 7.34M shares from 7.82M at March 31, although its stake rose to 21.2% because buybacks cut the share count. FMR came back above 5% (6.0%). The stock is down ~9.5% on the day before the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The +26.5% on 2026-09-09 came with short interest near its 8.0M peak. The squeeze contribution is not separable.
findings.why_not_priced: Short-interest data is public, so this is about the reaction function, not unseen information. It means a beat gets less mechanical covering than the September print did. The day-before drop says longs de-risked, which cuts the other way, so the size is kept small.

findings.finding: e.l.f. Beauty reported on 2026-11-04 that fiscal Q2 net sales rose 51% to $521M, and it raised its FY guide to +22-24%. US mass/prestige color cosmetics demand in the same quarter was healthy, so ODD's Il Makiage weakness is company-specific (the ad channel), not category demand.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: none on record for peer read-through on ODD
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer print from after ODD last spoke, but it is widely read, and much of e.l.f.'s growth is Rhode. A strong peer can also mean share taken from Il Makiage, so the sign is weak.
findings.independence: https://finviz.com/news/416340/elf-beauty-crushes-q2-and-raises-again-but-guidance-implies-a-sharp-second-half-slowdown (e.l.f. guides H2 to only +7-10%, so the category may be slowing into Q4).

findings.finding: Goldman Sachs set a $9 price target on 2026-09-09 against a ~$16.5 price, and other recent street targets clustered at $11-17 with a consensus near Hold/Sell. findings.why_not_priced: Public and stale: the targets predate the stock's rise from $16.5 to $20. A $9 target against $16 looks odd and may be a data error. Filed small for completeness.

lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a reaction): the reported-quarter beat finding cut from +1.0 to +0.5, because the Q1 2026 revenue beat was sold -29.6% and guidance has set the sign every time this year.

Lessons section 'reaction history built from the wrong events': rebuilt the base rate from the three confirmed 2026 prints (|49.2|, |29.6|, |26.5|), raising abs_move_pct from 22 to 24; the scaled number moves from +1.32 to +1.44.
Lessons 5 and 7 left the Meta-price proxy (-1.0), the Similarweb proxy (+1.0) and the positioning item (-0.5) standing: all small, short interest checked and not crowded.
